name: lnp-lab
description: Bring old LNP spreadsheets into LNP Lab: Claude reads and maps them, the server checks every row with the app's own rules and writes only after you approve the report. Claude reads your lab data, which is sent to Anthropic; this server itself sends nothing over the network.
long_description:
An optional, local bridge between Claude and the LNP Lab app (macOS). Claude reads your Excel or CSV files, maps their columns to LNP Lab's fields and calls a dry run; the server checks every row with the same rules the app uses and returns a quality report: what is importable, what goes to quarantine and why, what is a duplicate. Nothing is written until you have read the report and approved it. Every import can be undone whole from LNP Lab's Settings.

**Privacy (draft wording, to be replaced by the lab's own text).** With this extension, Claude reads your lab data: the files you give it and what the LNP Lab tools return. That data is sent to Anthropic, which runs Claude, as part of your conversation, under the terms of your Claude account. The LNP Lab server itself sends nothing over the network: it only reads and writes the LNP Lab database on this Mac and the files you name. Many labs treat formulation data as confidential, and some do not allow AI tools: check before you install it. LNP Lab works fully without it.

The server writes to the database only while LNP Lab is closed.
